body.voice_description: Create an original chess-coach voice for an illustrated character. Character: Restrained observer from Havana who notices exactly what changed. Voice direction: Soft female mezzo speaking English with a Cuban Spanish accent. Quiet, clear observations with gentle pauses and a calm, settled conclusion. Fluent spoken English, with the requested accent. Normal conversational pace with clear teaching emphasis; aim for an eight-to-ten-second passage without long dramatic pauses. Clean, dry studio recording, one intelligible voice, no music, background noise or animal sounds. Finish the final word completely with a natural settled ending. An original character voice, not an imitation of a named person or existing character.
body.text: One thing changed. The defender moved, and the piece it guarded is now alone. The other side can take it. Look at that square again.
